name: MAMMBA Workflows
description: Premium workflow APIs for business intelligence, lead generation, research, content creation, document processing, and AI agent automation.

endpoints.description: Search for businesses by industry + location, enrich with website/contact scraping, score leads, generate outreach opportunities.
Comprehensive website audit: SEO, CWV, technologies, accessibility, content, conversions.
Find businesses, analyze, score, generate personalized outreach messages.
Analyze target business, identify competitors, compare services and positioning.
Industry research: demand, competitors, segments, trends, opportunities, risks.
Generate social media content: hooks, scripts, captions, hashtags, CTAs, calendar.
SEO content: keyword research, title, meta, article, FAQ, structured data.
Company enrichment: description, industry, services, location, public contacts.
Public reputation analysis: review sentiment, strengths, issues, recommendations.
Generate structured business proposals: executive summary, scope, deliverables, timeline, pricing.
Comprehensive business blueprint: overview, customers, revenue, competition, startup plan, 90-day action.
Document intelligence: extract text, summarize, entities, dates, action items.
Invoice extraction: vendor, invoice #, dates, currency, subtotal, tax, total, line items.
Contract analysis: parties, obligations, dates, payment terms, clauses, legal review questions.
Multi-step deep research: plan, multi-source search, evidence synthesis, sources.
Business due diligence: company research, reputation, news, risks, strengths, verified labels.
Social media analysis: profile overview, content patterns, topics, engagement indicators.
Candidate analysis: resume vs job description, skills match, experience, interview questions.
Business email generation: cold outreach, follow-ups, sales sequences, partnership, responses.
AI agent task executor: classify, plan, execute subtasks with controlled tool registry.

note: All endpoints use x402 payment protocol (v1 and v2). Prices in USDC on Base Network (eip155:8453). For production use, ensure x402 payment headers are included.
